description: Clinical type hierarchy, aligned with FHIR R4 resource types. Every category has a default type; a concept can narrow it. A type with a concept family groups its records under shared concepts.

clinical_types.label: Observation
clinical_types.description: A measured, observed or reported finding about the patient.

clinical_types.label: Vital sign
clinical_types.description: Blood pressure, heart rate, temperature, respiratory rate or oxygen saturation.

clinical_types.label: Body measurement
clinical_types.description: Body weight, height or body mass index.

clinical_types.label: Body composition
clinical_types.description: Body fat or other composition estimates, including ranges.

clinical_types.label: Laboratory result
clinical_types.description: A single analyte result from a laboratory or screening test.

clinical_types.label: Laboratory commentary
clinical_types.description: Laboratory report text without a result value.

clinical_types.label: Symptom
clinical_types.description: A symptom the patient reports, including explicit absence.

clinical_types.label: Exposure
clinical_types.description: A reported intake or exposure such as alcohol, food or a substance.

clinical_types.label: Physical activity
clinical_types.description: An exercise routine or a single exercise session.

clinical_types.label: Sleep
clinical_types.description: Patient-reported sleep for one night: duration, bed and wake times, awakenings, naps and quality.

clinical_types.label: Social history
clinical_types.description: Tobacco, alcohol, occupation and other social history from a clinical record.

clinical_types.label: Diagnostic report
clinical_types.description: A laboratory or diagnostic report that groups results.

clinical_types.label: Medication use
clinical_types.description: Any record about taking, prescribing or changing a medication or supplement.

clinical_types.label: Medication statement
clinical_types.description: A medication or supplement regimen the patient takes or took.

clinical_types.label: Medication request
clinical_types.description: A prescription.

clinical_types.label: Medication administration
clinical_types.description: A single dose given or taken.

clinical_types.label: Medication change
clinical_types.description: A start, stop or dose change of a regimen.

clinical_types.label: Clinical care
clinical_types.description: Care delivery records from a clinical source.

clinical_types.label: Condition
clinical_types.description: A diagnosis or problem recorded by a clinician.

clinical_types.label: Encounter
clinical_types.description: A visit or other care encounter.

clinical_types.label: Encounter reason
clinical_types.description: The stated reason for a visit.

clinical_types.label: Procedure
clinical_types.description: A procedure performed on the patient.

clinical_types.label: Immunization
clinical_types.description: A vaccine given.

clinical_types.label: Allergy
clinical_types.description: An allergy or intolerance, or a recorded absence of one.

clinical_types.label: Care plan
clinical_types.description: A clinician care plan.

clinical_types.label: Care team
clinical_types.description: Clinicians responsible for the patient.

clinical_types.label: Goal
clinical_types.description: A clinical goal.

clinical_types.label: Clinical note
clinical_types.description: A clinician-authored note.

clinical_types.label: Patient instruction
clinical_types.description: Instructions given to the patient.

clinical_types.label: Administrative
clinical_types.description: Administrative records.

clinical_types.label: Coverage
clinical_types.description: Insurance coverage.

clinical_types.label: Patient statement
clinical_types.description: An interpretation, preference or context the patient states. Never a clinical finding.

clinical_types.label: Patient hypothesis
clinical_types.description: What the patient thinks may explain something. Causality is not established.

clinical_types.label: Reported association
clinical_types.description: A link the patient reports between two things. Causality is not established.

clinical_types.label: Medication response
clinical_types.description: How the patient reports responding to a treatment.

clinical_types.label: Care preference
clinical_types.description: What the patient wants or does not want from care.

clinical_types.label: Measurement context
clinical_types.description: Conditions around a measurement, such as time of day or what preceded it.

clinical_types.label: Recurring pattern
clinical_types.description: A pattern the patient reports recurring over time.

clinical_types.label: Patient context
clinical_types.description: Background history or circumstances the patient provides.

clinical_types.label: Check-in tracking
clinical_types.description: What the patient agreed the daily check-in should ask, and how. A preference, never a clinical finding.

clinical_types.label: Patient profile
clinical_types.description: Facts about the patient as a person.

clinical_types.label: Demographics
clinical_types.description: Age, sex and other demographics the patient reports.

clinical_types.label: Conversation
clinical_types.description: The preserved health conversation, as audit evidence.

clinical_types.label: Conversation message
clinical_types.description: One user or assistant message, verbatim.

clinical_types.label: Conversation session
clinical_types.description: One conversation thread.
